standardLocal.reuse: Standard run used the final runtime. Only tests/ability-picker.spec.ts and tests/fixtures/abilities/main.ts changed afterward, to expose/wait for actual fixture readiness. Tooling, unit, production-build and core-journey inputs remain unchanged. Final typecheck and complete affected dev fixture checks ran again; prior broader fixture failures are not relabeled as passes.

findings.fix: One radial preview publication for Tab, pointer/native activation and held release; update all three direct constructor harnesses.
Reject non-Move shortcuts before choosing a plan destination.
Keyboard shortcuts target the latest cursor after changing skins.
Share tactical self-heal description across chip, accessible name, hub and full HUD.
Reuse shared warning/range/effect formatting; explicit friendly radial dialog bound to the exact state and intent/plan; cancellation preserves state/RNG and stale acceptance commits nothing.
Share the existing camera render checkpoint, expose the real fixture scene-ready callback, wait for it before input and settle every skin switch before projected taps.
